items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I passed by and he said: “Do you here this?”

ctx.x: But I remember once being at that Lennox school and hearing George Coleman standing out in the woods playing that line, or in his room. I guess that was it. I passed by and he said: “Do you here this?” and he went [vocally imitates the line].
Now that you mention this it’s a good time to ask you somewhere in this time period you got married, right?
